I answered Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team: the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is 382 seats.

Tobias posted that number in #central-team on Oct 14. I checked that Hollis is a member there, so he could already see it. Nothing posted in the channel since then changes it. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the account team.
